population.opponent_deck: Known full decks, matching native adapter.
population.independence: All perspectives and rows of each battle kept together; identical side-canonical card trajectories deduplicated.

concepts.title: Elapsed match time
concepts.definition: Explicit clock; encoder saturates at 450 s.

concepts.title: Own estimated elixir
concepts.definition: Replay reconstruction, not authoritative game elixir.

concepts.title: Opponent estimated elixir
concepts.definition: Replay reconstruction, not authoritative game elixir.

concepts.title: Opponent historical left-lane fraction
concepts.definition: Fraction of prior opponent card plays on the left; not live troops.

concepts.title: Own spend over last 30 s
concepts.definition: Exact replay deployment-cost sum under the project cost table.

concepts.title: Opponent spend over last 30 s
concepts.definition: Exact replay deployment-cost sum under the project cost table.

concepts.title: Opponent distinct cards played
concepts.definition: Number of distinct opponent cards in the confirmed prefix.

concepts.title: Last opponent deployment x
concepts.definition: Most recent opponent deployment location; not current unit position.

concepts.title: Double-or-later clock phase
concepts.definition: Observation clock >=120 s, matching this encoder, not a current rules claim.

concepts.title: Opponent win condition played within 5 s
concepts.definition: Exact deployment-history tag, not evidence that the unit is alive.

concepts.title: Opponent Hog Rider played within 5 s
concepts.definition: Exact deployment-history tag, not a live Hog detector.

concepts.title: Last opponent play was left
concepts.definition: Last confirmed opponent x < arena midpoint.

concepts.title: Most recent event was opponent
concepts.definition: Perspective-normalized side of the final observed event.

label_audit.hp_accuracy_status: Not estimable from audited, sufficiently independent aligned labels in this study. Missing tower entries are NOT automatically treated as destroyed.
